title: Group Exercise
intro: Group X classes enhance the overall physical fitness and wellness of our patrons.

sections.markdown:
Currently, there are no scheduled activities planned for the near future. See all [upcoming events](https://pendleton.usmc-mccs.org/calendar-of-events).

sections.heading: Group - X Class Descriptions
sections.markdown:
**CYCLE**
60-minute indoor cycle class simulating outdoor riding with sprinting, intervals, and hill work. Bring water and a towel.

**FAMILY FITNESS**
This is a mommy-and-me fitness class, all ages and strollers are welcome. Parental supervision required.

**LATIN DANCE**
Learn different styles of Latin Dance like Bachata, Salsa, Cumbia, and Merengue.

**LESMILLS VIRTUAL CLASS: RPM CYCLE**
An easy, fun, and intense indoor cycle workout with great music pumping and the group spinning as one on a journey of hill climbs, sprints, and flat riding.

**LESMILLS VIRTUAL CLASS: BODY BALANCE**
This is a perfect mix of yoga, tai chi, and pilates created to build functional strength and improve flexibility. Participants strengthen the entire body and leave feeling calm and centered.

**POWER YOGA**
A vigorous, fitness-based approach to vinyasa-style yoga. Teachers have flexibility to teach poses in any order, emphasizing strength and flexibility.

**STRONG**
Combines high-intensity interval training with the science of Synced Music Motivation for an intense, full-body workout.

**STRONG YOGA**
Improve balance, flexibility, mobility, and core strength while learning mental relaxation and stress relief.

sections.heading: Specialty Class Descriptions
sections.markdown:
**ZUMBA**
This cardio-Latin fusion class features aerobic interval training to maximize fat burning and total body toning, all to incredible music with moves that are easy to learn! For more info call: (760) 763-0657
